sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Huntsman Path - Woods Keeper is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "For many years working as a gamekeeper, I know that if there is an infection in the forest, then you need to get rid of it immediately before the whole forest gets infected. One such infection settled here, they call it Shturman, he and his crew set up at the sawmill, so now I don't feel safe even in my own reserve. Deal with it, it will be for the better for the forest and the people. But be careful, Shturman has friends, and they all can shoot well."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Eliminate Shturman
- Find 1 Shturman's stash key in raid
- Hand over 1 Shturman's stash key to Jaeger

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +18,000 EXP
- Jaeger Rep +0.02
- 4× Gunpowder "Hawk"
- 1× VPX Flash Storage Module
- 3× TerraGroup Labs access keycard
- Unlocks purchase of Remington Model 700 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle (variant ARCH) at Jaeger LL3

- Unlocks purchase of Remington Model 700 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle (variant AICS) at Jaeger LL3

- Unlocks purchase of Remington Model 700 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle (variant PRO) at Jaeger LL4

- Unlocks barter for Remington Model 700 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle (variant MRS) at Jaeger LL4

"So you made Shturman finally leave the sawmill. Well, not bad, many people can breathe in peace now. I might even move closer to the city myself, closer to home. Here's the reward, found some strange stashes in the woods, and that's what was in them. I don't need them, but you might find them useful."

In this quest you have to kill Shturman and find his stash key in raid.
